13.1.name: JAM.State
13.1.note: no separate record: π is the fields `valStats`, `valStatsLast`, `coreStats` and `serviceStats`

13.2.name: JAM.ValidatorRecord
13.2.note: π_V and π_L are lists of these

13.3.name: JAM.validatorStats
13.3.note: not enforced by the types; `validatorStats` gives π′_V the length |κ′|; on an epoch change π′_L is π†_V (length |π_V|), otherwise π_L unchanged

13.4.name: JAM.validatorStats
13.4.note: over the indices of π_V, which number |κ| (eq. 13.3)

13.7.name: JAM.CoreRecord
13.7.note: π_C is a list of these, of length 𝖢 (`coreStats`)

13.8.name: JAM.ServiceRecord
13.8.note: π_S maps service ids to these

13.17.name: JAM.serviceStats
13.17.note: summed field by field over `ds`; the counter is `ds.length`
